items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: My father was playing drum, the Razzatea was playing clarinet... That was the first Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: Speaking on this, we were saying a few minutes ago, we were talking about the band at the Tuxedo and the dance club. Yeah, the Tuxedo was organized in the year of 1910.

I don't remember the exact month or date, but I did get that information from the picture, which William Ridgely, maybe Ridgely had died not so long ago, he had of the Tuxedo band. And that original Tuxedo band, it was Ridgely on trombone, Celestine on trumpet. My father was playing drum, the Razzatea was playing clarinet, Peter Boccage was playing violin. And it was at the Tuxedo club, somewhere down in Stewartville or the old district. Frankman Street. Somewhere along there. That was the first Tuxedo band. And…
You met him? Oh yeah. Is he still living? Oh no. No, he's dead now.
